1  ORDER

The petitioner is the sole accused in SC No.843/2023 pending before the Fast Track Special Court,
Kottarakara, arising out of Crime No.1948/2022 of Kundara Police Station, Kollam.
The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 354, 450, 376, 376(2)(n) and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. The prosecution case is that, the accused after promising to marry the defacto complainant, took her to various places and committed rape upon her and thereafter refused to marry her and thereby he is alleged to have committed the above offences.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, the entire dispute between the petitioner and the defacto complainant has been settled and therefore, she prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.
4. The petition was strongly opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.
5. On a perusal of the F.I.Statement, it can be seen that the petitioner and the defacto complainant were in love affair.

As 2025:KER:93573 demanded by the petitioner, the defacto complainant accompanied him to different places on different dates and they had physical relationship.
6.

The claim of the defacto complainant that the petitioner had sexual relationship with her against her wish and interest appears to be unbelievable as even on several subsequent dates, she accompanied him to various places and permitted him to have sexual relationship.
Now, there is every reason to believe that the relationship between the petitioner and the defacto complainant was purely consensual in nature.

Therefore, the entire dispute has been settled with the defacto complainant and the petitioner and it is revealed from the affidavit filed by her in support of the Crl.M.C.
7.
The learned Public Prosecutor also, upon instructions, submitted that the defacto complainant had given signed statement in tune with the affidavit filed by her before this Court.
In the above circumstance, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the proceedings against the petitioner and as such this Crl.M.C is liable to be allowed.
In the result, this Crl.M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner/accused in SC No.843/2023 on 2025:KER:93573 the file of the Fast Track Special Court, Kottarakara, arising from Crime No.1948/2022 of Kundara Police Station, Kollam, stands quashed under Section 528 of the BNSS.

Sd/-
C.PRATHEEP KUMAR JUDGE ma/03.12.2025 Delish.
